Class AdocUnionMojo

java.lang.Object
network.ike.plugin.AdocUnionMojo
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.apache.maven.api.plugin.Mojo
@Mojo(name="adoc-union", defaultPhase="generate-sources") public class AdocUnionMojo extends Object implements org.apache.maven.api.plugin.Mojo
Unpacks every topic library a module declares into one AsciiDoc union per repository, <reactor root>/target/generated-sources/adoc, and checks that the module's own includes resolve there (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1342; design topic dev-adoc-packages in ike-lab-documents). It replaces the stock unpack-dependencies execution for adoc zips.

A library lays its root out as packages, <group>/<domain>/<topic>.adoc, and ships a manifest at META-INF/ike/<group>/<artifact>/manifest.yaml listing them. The goal:

  • resolves the module's dependencies with classifier adoc and type zip, transitively, as unpack-dependencies does;
  • copies an external library's content from its zip, and links the package directories of a library that is a module of the same reactor to its src/docs/asciidoc, so an edit reached through an include changes the real source (ike.adoc.link, default true). Whether IntelliJ resolves includes, previews and navigates through such a link is to be confirmed by KEC on one machine;
  • treats a zip without a manifest as a legacy library: refused, naming the artifact, unless ike.adoc.legacy=true, which unpacks it into the legacy per-module directory as before;
  • refuses two libraries that ship one package, naming both;
  • is idempotent from every module, so a -pl build works: an unchanged library is not rewritten, and an entry whose library no module declares anymore is left alone, since the union is per repository and not per module;
  • verifies that every include::{adoc}/... and include::{topics}/... in the module's src/docs/asciidoc resolves in the union, and fails the build for one that does not with the exact <dependency> block to add, found in the union's manifests and then in the local repository by the group prefix of the path. It never fetches an undeclared library;
  • sets the project properties adoc and topics to the union, so the asciidoctor plugin's attributes can reference them. While a legacy library was unpacked, topics names the legacy directory instead, so the old include lines keep resolving until the last consumer migrates.

The module itself, when its own source root has the package layout, is linked into the union too, so a library's own {adoc} includes resolve in a build of that module alone.

Typical wiring, in ike-parent (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1343): 

<execution>
    <id>adoc-union</id>
    <phase>generate-sources</phase>
    <goals><goal>adoc-union</goal></goals>
</execution>

Modules of a -T reactor share the union, so the goal serializes its writes JVM-wide.
